last.verdict: Profit growth slowed and missed estimates, with China and US beer sales both shrinking.

reasons.label: Profit slightly short
reasons.text: Core profit rose 3.9% to $5.96B, a bit below the roughly $5.98B analysts expected.

reasons.label: China sales collapse
reasons.text: China volumes fell 16.8% and its profit dropped 30.5%, with the industry also weak.

reasons.label: Margins and US slip
reasons.text: Profit margin fell to 36.1% on higher marketing and costs; US volumes dropped 2.5%.

story: Growth has been steady but unspectacular. Profit beat in July, helped by World Cup volumes, yet China and US weakness persisted. The 4%-8% profit growth outlook is unchanged, and the stock has swung between small gains and small drops.

history.verdict: Beat on profit and volumes, but a big run-up left only a small gain.

reasons.label: Profit beat
reasons.text: Organic operating profit rose 5.8%, above the 4.6% analysts expected.

reasons.label: World Cup volume lift
reasons.text: Volumes grew 0.9%, a second straight rise; management still expects a 25 basis point World Cup boost despite Brazil and Mexico exiting early.

reasons.label: Weak US and China
reasons.text: US sales to retailers and wholesalers fell, and China volumes dropped 9.7%.
